label: B2 from the selected-grounding closure and the ground-to-esse-cause bridge
description: Support option for B2 from the grounding family on the shared frame. Not a transcription: the closure gives a ground, the bridge converts it into a distinct esse-cause, and the interface supplies concreteness. Each premise is needed (controls, models 7-9) and the bundle is satisfiable nonvacuously (model 10). It shares the closure with the existing grounding route to the First Way's mover, so it adds a connection, not independent warrant. Establishes no premise.
